technique_name: Write an essay about the role of technology in education.
description: Technology has become a vital part of education in the 21st century. From digital textbooks to virtual classrooms, technology has revolutionized the way students learn and interact with their teachers in the classroom. With the emergence of Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning, we have witnessed advancements in educational technology offerings such as personalized learning, adaptive systems and predictive analytics.
